blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has released its long-awaited communication related to the US$100-million settlement between the Marinduque provincial government and Canadian-firm Barrick Gold Corporation over the 1995 Marcopper mine disaster that has polluted Marinduque waterways for decades, according to the Marinduque Council for Environmental Concerns (MACEC).
